newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Mozambique's top criminal shot dead by police.
newsitem.headline: Mozambique's top criminal shot dead by police.

text.p: Mozambique's most wanted criminal, Nicolau Cuinica, better known as Nequinha, died in a gun battle with police on Wednesday hours after he killed two people in a bank raid, newspapers said on Thursday.
The Maputo daily Noticias said Nequinha, 19, died in a shootout with police which lasted several hours in the southern provincial capital of Xai-Xai.
Two members of his gang were also shot dead. One policeman was killed and another wounded.
Noticias published a photograph of the blood-spattered bodies of the three wanted men, one of them handcuffed.
Nequinha and his gang were wanted on several charges of burglary, car theft and rape in the industrial capital Matola.

He was also sought on charges of escaping from Maputo's Machava maximum security prison several times. His last escape was on December 6 and police said he later committed crimes using a gun he had seized from one of the prison warders.
Hours before Nequinha was killed, police said he shot dead two people in a bank raid outside Maputo. Police later traced him to a boarding house in Xai-Xai where he and his gang members were killed.
